subject: The solution didn’t have to wait.
preheader: Funding approval was being worked through. We were already helping get the right setup in place.
intro: We’ve been helping an OT arrange a bed and mattress setup for someone who was hiring a bed.
The mattress trial had gone well. The mattress was already in use at home, and the OT had completed the report. The next step was to bring the replacement bed and accessories together.
Funding approval was still being worked through. In the meantime, there was work we could get underway.
sectionTitle: Making it work for the person.
body: We worked with the OT on the complete setup and began coordinating delivery while the funding arrangements were being finalised.
The person could keep using the mattress that had worked in the trial, while we organised the next steps towards replacing the hired bed.

For us, that flexibility is part of looking after the person. It means understanding their circumstances, working out what’s possible and helping get the solution in place while the funding process continues.
actionText: If you’re working through a similar situation, tell us what the person needs and where things stand. We’ll work through the options with you.
ctaLabel: Talk to us about a case
teamName: The Sleep Choice x Supply Ministry Team
trialFooterText: In-home trial options and availability depend on the equipment and service area.
